title: The Media Bias Detector: A Framework for Annotating and Analyzing the News at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Using LLMs with chain-of-thought prompting to evaluate the political lean of news articles and headlines on an 11-point scale (pro-Democrat to pro-Republican) and identifying partisan focus at the sentence level.
Scraping news homepages to record article prominence and using contextual embeddings to cluster articles into events, measuring which topics and events publishers choose to cover or ignore.

Using LLMs to annotate the tone (positive, negative, or neutral) of articles, headlines, and individual sentences, as well as classifying sentence types (fact, opinion, quote) to assess how stories are presented.
Analyzing the tone labels assigned by LLMs across different news topics and publishers to quantify the prevalence of negative coverage, particularly in political news.
